meta_title: Topmindspace — local stream, presentations, writing, handoff
meta_description: Topmind keeps a personal stream in local Markdown and writes organization or todos only after you confirm. The same page covers slide decks, writing skills, and a portable handoff file.
og_title: Topmindspace — local stream, presentations, writing, handoff
og_description: A local-first personal stream, plus presentation, writing, and handoff skills.
topmind_lede: A local-first personal stream. Notes, clips, and documents land on a timeline as Markdown in your workspace. Suggestions and todos are drafted first and written only after you confirm.
topmind_note: The desktop app runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux. The command below is the macOS Homebrew install.
topmind_img_alt: Topmind desktop: navigation, this week’s stream, and a suggestions panel
peers_lead: Three separate installs. Presentation finishes a deck, writing skills finish articles and covers, and handoff carries context to another tool.
pres_lede: A skill for formal business decks. Three shapes: a talk, a research report, or an architecture brief. Day to day you page through HTML; when the layout needs editing, export an editable PPTX. Nine visual styles switch inside the same file.
write_lede: One installer, four skills. WeChat posts go from rewrite to inline layout; X longform turns Markdown into text you can paste; briefs explain one thing; covers are cropped for X and WeChat.
hand_lede: Working habits, projects, and memories go into one Markdown file, a header plus six sections. Export it, diff it in the next tool, and merge only after you confirm. No account and no server.
